description: Nyuchi MCP server. Plugs into the mukoko-edge Cloudflare Worker as new sub-routes under /v1/mcp/. First sub-route: /v1/mcp/design (design system tools). Reads from Supabase grjsboqkaywpwatvrzmy via the existing gateway Supabase connection pattern. The MCP and the design REST API are both new sub-routes in the existing mukoko-edge API Gateway Worker — not separate Worker deployments.
notes: New routes in mukoko-edge repo. Design REST API at api.nyuchi.com/v1/design/*. MCP at api.nyuchi.com/v1/mcp/design (also served at mcp.nyuchi.dev/design via route alias). The Supabase design registry project (grjsboqkaywpwatvrzmy) is the new data source alongside existing platform Supabase projects.
